text: おさげの　おんなのこが　れんがの　みちを　あるいてる…　…もう　いかなきゃ！
note: This describes The Wizard of Oz (1939), in which Dorothy, a girl in pigtails, follows the yellow brick road. It is the girl player's counterpart to the film the boy player sees.
claim: In the 1939 film The Wizard of Oz, Dorothy wears pigtails and walks along the yellow brick road.
